shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone surface
horizontal band of repeated pattern (zigzag/fringe-like register divider)
justification: Both are shallow relief on an upright stone slab, with profile figures and a horizontal patterned band separating zones, plus a small isolated disc motif in each. But A is a single, anatomically detailed, densely textured anthropomorphic figure filling the whole panel with crisp, controlled modelling, whereas B is a sequence of schematic, sparsely spaced animal forms in coarse, low outline relief on a shaped pillar, so the compositional logic and carving hand are quite different.
